captureAdmin.title: Capture address
captureAdmin.intro: Forward or BCC any mail to it: it joins the record its subject names (an order, a quote, an inquiry…), else the customer's or supplier's conversation; what it cannot place waits in Mail to sort. Only a colleague's own mail that passes DMARC is matched.

noDomain.title: Add your mail domain first
noDomain.body: The capture address lives at the domain that receives replies (above).

none.title: No capture address yet
none.body: Make one, then forward or BCC any mail to it.

captureAdmin.lands: Mail it cannot place goes to
captureAdmin.defaultHint: A team inbox, or Mail to sort
captureAdmin.noAddress: No address: the company receives no mail at a domain now.

held.noRight: Needs the right to manage team inboxes

replace.title: Replace the capture address?
replace.body: A new address is made and the old one stops at once: mail sent to it is no longer matched and waits in Mail to sort as any other mail. Tell your colleagues the new one.

turnOff.title: Turn off the capture address?
turnOff.body: No mail is matched through it any more: forwarded mail waits in Mail to sort. You can make a new address later.

notice.changed: The capture address changed meanwhile: it was read again.
notice.forbidden: You may not change the capture address.
notice.invalid: Not accepted as it is: it was read again.
notice.unavailable: Nexus cannot be reached right now.

done.made: The capture address is ready: copy it and forward mail to it.
done.replaced: Replaced: the old address no longer works.
done.turnedOff: Turned off: no mail is matched through it any more.
done.pointed: Saved: mail it cannot place goes there now.
